title.en: Fable 16 — The Goose and the Golden Eggs

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A man and his wife had a goose in the yard.

sentences.ar: בוקר אחד הם מצאו ביצה מוזרה.
sentences.en: One morning they found a strange egg.
It was heavy and very yellow.
The man took it to the market to check.

sentences.ar: הסוחר אמר: זאת ביצה של זהב.
sentences.en: The merchant said: this is an egg of gold.
On the second morning there was another egg.
And also on the third day, and on the fourth.

sentences.ar: הם קנו בית חדש ובגדים חדשים.
sentences.en: They bought a new house and new clothes.

sentences.ar: אחרי חודש האיש אמר לאשתו: זה לאט.
sentences.en: After a month the man said to his wife: this is slow.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ביצה אחת בכל יום.
sentences.en: He said: one egg every day.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: בטח יש בפנים הרבה זהב.
sentences.en: He said: surely there is a lot of gold inside.
She said: perhaps it is worth waiting.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: לא, אני רוצה הכול היום.
sentences.en: He said: no, I want everything today.
He took a knife and went to the yard.
After a minute he came back to the house.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אין שם כלום בכלל.
sentences.en: He said: there is nothing there at all.

sentences.ar: ומאותו יום לא הייתה עוד ביצה.
sentences.en: And from that day there was no more egg.

sentences.ar: מי שרוצה הכול מאבד גם את המעט.
sentences.en: Whoever wants everything loses even the little.
